local_tick_count.derivation: SDK PsLoop13f4 loads r1 from literal149c=0x0a940008. At13f6 it reads lowspeed_1b2_mode; zero branches at13fc to168e. At1690 UBFX r0,r7,#2,#16; at1694 STRH r0,[r1]. r7 is original dram_clk from entry ldrd r7,r5,[r1], with no frequency scaling for board tpr13bit2 clear and lowspeed flag0. Thus floor(1800/4)=450. Other frequency and lowspeed branches must be recomputed.
local_tick_count.agreement: NXP names the low11 bits as DFI clock cycles per microsecond. 450MHz therefore implies450 ticks/us. This target-specific host write independently confirms the units and value, avoiding transplantation of NXP pstate_freq/8 formula.
local_tick_count.nonexecutability: This is a scalar MASTER configuration CSR, not descriptor, IMEM, DMEM or PIE instruction storage.

practical_stages.action: After SYS_CFG273f and both controllers held, mux0/micro1 permit readonly static observation. No prerequisite write9 is required solely for these reads. Read20004/2008b/20090 plus20310/20311/20326/20327 as explicit candidates.

Keep both controllers held and all DRAM clients off. Assert MicroReset9, verify mux0. Configure approved source PLL/analog static fields separately, establish Hclk/Ucclk3, assert ZCalReset1, and set tick count450, PState0, PorControl1 with per-write readback. Preserve reset-held DRAM context; no DDR-device MR/ZQ command is issued.

Require ZCalRun0 and PU/PD override bits0 clear. Write ZCalReset0, ZCalRun1, wait a measured interval at least35us (100us is a conservative experiment choice), write ZCalRun0, and collect raw reset/run/PU/PD and context values. Stop on the first failing access; no automatic retry or cleanup writes.

Return TIMED_ONLY. Changed or stable nonzero PU/PD codes are observations, not proof of fresh calibration completion or valid ohms. No DDR reads, training success, boot integration or storage writes follow solely from this result.
